subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Virtual worlds are recently new phenomena in that they _________ people to meet and socially interact with others in a variety of online environments.
solution:
The correct answer is: Enable.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"enable"** means to make something possible or easy to do. (सक्षम बनाना)
 
• **​"Enable" **refers to giving someone the means or ability to do something.
 
 
• **Example: **The internet **enables **people to access information from anywhere in the world.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word to fill in the blank is **'enable'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

**Complete Sentence:** *Virtual worlds are recently new phenomena in that they **enable__** people to meet and socially interact with others in a variety of online environments.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Forbid **(मना करना): To order someone not to do something.

 
 
• **Example:** The school rules **forbid **students from using mobile phones during class.
 
 
 
• **Bring **(लाना ): To take or go with someone or something to a place.
 
 
• **Example: **Please **bring **your books to the study session.
 
 
 
• **Choose** (चुनना): To select from a number of possibilities.
 
 
• **Example:** You need to **choose **the right tool for the job.
